rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the work is done with meticulous care, even if the slow pace is not stressed.

example.english: I painstakingly proofread the report several times.
example.traditional: 我仔仔細細咁將份報告校對咗幾次。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 zi2 sai3 sai3 gam3 zoeng1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gaau3 deoi3 zo2 gei2 ci3

rows.note: Use this when the sentence foregrounds the deliberately slow pace of carrying out the work.

example.english: I painstakingly opened the package slowly because I was afraid of damaging what was inside.
example.traditional: 我慢慢咁拆開個包裝，驚整爛入面件嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maan6 maan2 gam3 caak3 hoi1 go3 baau1 zong1 geng1 zing2 laan6 jap6 min6 gin6 je5
